jobs.title: Swimply: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Arlington, Virginia, United States
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/uA8SVcAxYcFwjnCSsND9Vp/jobs-at-swimply

About Swimply

Swimply is the marketplace that lets homeowners rent out their private pools, hot tubs, courts and backyards by the hour. Thousands of hosts across the United States and Canada use Swimply to share space they already own with families and small groups in their community.

Because hourly backyard rentals are new, most local codes were written before they existed. Towns, counties, health departments and homeowners associations regularly try to fit Swimply into rules written for hotels, public pools, home businesses or overnight short-term rentals. We are building a dedicated regulatory function to manage those matters at scale and to move the rules in our favor, state by state.

You will own the day-to-day operation of the program and work directly with our General Counsel, our CEO, our Head of Operations and the outside lobbyists and local counsel we retain.

The Role

The Regulatory Affairs Manager runs Swimply's regulatory program end to end. Half of the job is operational: every notice a host or the company receives is logged, answered and tracked to a close. The other half is strategic: finding the bills, partners and officials that let us fix the rules for a whole state at once instead of town by town.

What You Will Do

Run the notice program

  • Own the regulatory intake: the regulatory inbox, the host reporting form and escalations from the Host Success team.
  • Log every cease-and-desist letter, notice of violation, HOA demand and listing takedown in the regulatory tracker, by state, city, issuing agency and legal theory.
  • Sort each matter by the theory being used against us: public pool classification, home occupation or zoning, short-term rental rules, business licensing and tax, or HOA covenants.
  • Send the approved standard response to the host or code officer, and follow up until the matter is closed or escalated.
  • Escalate to the General Counsel within one business day anything involving a subpoena, a records demand, a lawsuit, criminal exposure or a threat to a whole market.
  • Publish a weekly regulatory report for the CEO and General Counsel: new notices, open matters, trends and recommended next steps.

Change the rules, state by state

  • Track bills and ordinances in our priority states, starting with New Jersey, New York, California and Texas, and flag any short-term rental or health-code bill our language could be added to.
  • Keep our model state bill and model city ordinance current.
  • Prepare the testimony, one-pagers, fact sheets and talking points our lobbyists and executives use with legislators and staff.
  • Reach out directly to selected city planning, code enforcement and health departments to explain our safety standards before a problem starts.
  • Manage outside firms and budget.
  • Day-to-day manager for our lead lobbying firm, state lobbyists and local zoning counsel: scopes, weekly updates, deadlines and invoices.
  • Build and maintain a bench of zoning counsel and lobbyists in each problem state, ready for when a matter escalates.
  • Own the regulatory budget against the plan the board approves, and give leadership a clear cost-versus-outcome view before any new engagement is signed.

Build allies

  • Represent Swimply in short-term rental coalitions, state chambers of commerce, realtor associations and pool and spa industry groups.
  • Recruit and prepare hosts to speak at hearings and council meetings.

Keep us compliant

  • Handle lobbying registrations and periodic disclosure filings at the state and city level.
  • Support Finance on offers to collect and remit local taxes in jurisdictions that confirm our legality in writing.
  • Research permit, occupancy and licensing requirements for new products and new markets, including Canada, and brief the General Counsel and product teams.
  • Pull and organize platform data when counsel needs it to respond to a government request.

Required

  • 5 to 8 years in government affairs, public policy, regulatory operations or local government.
  • Hands-on experience with how state legislatures and city councils actually move a bill or ordinance: committees, staff, hearings and timing.
  • Experience managing outside vendors such as lobbying firms or consultants, including scopes and budgets.
  • Clear, plain-English writing. You can turn a zoning code section into a one-page explanation a homeowner or council member understands.
  • A system for high volume. You keep dozens of open matters across many states moving without losing one.
  • Calm, professional manner with code officers, health inspectors, HOA boards and frustrated hosts.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Policy or government affairs work at a sharing-economy or marketplace company, such as short-term rentals, space rentals, ride-share or car-sharing.
  • Experience as a legislative or council staffer, or in a city planning, zoning, code enforcement or public health department.
  • Existing relationships in New Jersey, New York, California or Texas.
  • Prior registration as a lobbyist, or experience handling lobbying disclosure filings.
  • Familiarity with pool safety, public health or short-term rental regulation.
  • Spanish proficiency.

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Our company isn't just scaling; we're redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by leading global enterprises including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey, we reduce human cyber risk through AI-driven automation, with Agentic AI expanding our capabilities even further.

In this company, support is where the product meets reality. Every ticket represents a customer telling us something true about the platform—and every issue is either something we repeatedly answer, or a problem we solve once and eliminate at the source. We view support as an integral extension of product engineering, not a downstream cost centre.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a high-calibre Technical Support Engineer to take full ownership of our tier-2/tier-3 technical customer support function. This is a technical, investigative engagement—not a script-reading helpdesk.

Operating as an independent contractor based in South Africa, you will manage customer issues end to end: diagnosing logs and error records, reproducing complex platform issues in dedicated test tenants, handing fully documented, reproduction-ready defect packages to the Product Lead, and actively closing the loop by removing recurring root causes from our product, documentation, or onboarding flows.

You will inherit a high-discipline, high-efficiency operational setup powered by modern observability, AI acceleration, and proactive tenant-level monitoring.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

End-to-End Case Resolution
  • Manage the inbound queue via Intercom, triaging by severity and business impact, meeting strict SLAs, and proactively setting clear expectations for next updates.
  • Conduct deep diagnostic investigations before reaching out to customers: analyze error/event records, audit logs, browser console outputs, network traces, API request/response payloads, mail flow, and multi-tenant configurations.
  • Reproduce issues in staging/test tenants. If an issue is elusive, correlate system data across tenant IDs, timestamps, and user telemetry to isolate the failure state.
  • Package and escalate verified defects directly to the Product Lead. Every escalation must contain reproduction steps, tenant/user IDs, UTC timestamps, relevant log excerpts, and ruled-out variables to allow immediate engineering action without rework.
  • Maintain complete ownership of the customer communication loop during escalation cycles, verifying hotfixes against your original reproduction steps prior to closing cases.
  • Monitor proactive health alerts across tenant accounts (e.g., in Sentry), identifying failures before customers do and initiating contact with pre-empted fixes.
  • Track bi-weekly release cycles: review release notes on deployment day, validate altered functionality in sandbox environments, and resolve pending customer cases impacted by updates.
Root-Cause Elimination & Product Evolution
  • Classify every resolved ticket by verified root cause: product defect, documentation gap, UX friction, environmental configuration, feature limitation, or edge-case anomaly.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis on repeating issue categories to identify architectural, operational, or instructional fixes.
  • Directly author and maintain Help Centre articles, implementation guides, and troubleshooting documentation to drive customer self-service.
  • Surface UX friction points to the Product Lead backed by empirical evidence (user journeys, reproduction paths, screenshots, and aggregate impact metrics).
  • Report on support metrics using empirical data: ticket volumes categorized by cause, trend trajectories, and high-impact preventative targets.
  • Leverage approved AI acceleration tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) responsibly to speed up technical research, verifying all outputs against source data prior to customer transmission.
  • 3+ years of technical support, application support, product support, or customer-facing engineering experience dedicated to a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform.
  • Proven track record supporting technical B2B enterprise buyers, such as CISOs, IT Directors, SOC teams, security engineers, or system administrators.
  • Demonstrated competency diagnosing multi-tenant architectures, recognizing tenant-specific misconfigurations versus global system incidents.
  • Strong working knowledge of web technologies: browser developer tools, HTTP status codes, REST APIs, JSON payloads, and log analysis.
  • Demonstrated history of systemic root-cause resolution (e.g., authored documentation that deflected ticket volume, initiated a UX change, or caught critical bugs).
  • Hands-on experience with modern support and service platforms (Intercom preferred; or Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot Service Hub, Front).
  • Flawless written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to convey technical diagnostics plainly and confidently under pressure.
  • Proven self-directed problem-solving ability, with an aptitude for learning complex platform capabilities directly from architecture docs.
  • Fully equipped home office environment in South Africa, including high-speed fibre internet, dedicated backup power (UPS/inverter) for load-shedding resilience, and quality AV peripherals.



PREFERRED:

  • Domain exposure to cybersecurity, secure email gateways, or human risk management platforms (e.g., KnowBe4, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Hoxhunt, Abnormal).
  • Working familiarity with enterprise mail flow systems: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC record handling.
  • Familiarity with identity architecture and directory integrations: SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, Active Directory, or Entra ID (Azure AD).
  • Practical ability to write and execute read-only SQL queries.
  • Exposure to modern web/cloud stacks (e.g., Cloudflare, Nuxt, Vue, PostgreSQL, Sentry).
  • Working knowledge of enterprise compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, UK GDPR) in a data-handling capacity.
  • Active Intercom certification (or commitment to achieve certification within 90 days of engagement).


What You’ll Bring:

  • Investigation-First Mindset: A refusal to guess or relay unverified theories. You look at logs, inspect configurations, reproduce the scenario, and present verified data.
  • Customer Empathy Without the Runaround: You never send the customer a boilerplate troubleshooting checklist for information you could pull from internal logs yourself.
  • Accountability & Integrity: You set expectations accurately (e.g., "I am investigating this log sequence and will update you by 14:00"), communicate transparently, and follow through predictably.
  • Calm, Consultative Demeanor: Composure and clarity when de-escalating frustrated enterprise customers.
  • Product-Minded Curiosity: An instinct to treat every resolved ticket as product feedback, asking why the problem existed and advocating for fixes that eliminate the issue permanently.

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you'll be the owner of the pet parent's path to enrollment, from the first flyer they see in an exam room to the moment they complete sign-up. You'll map the prospect journey, build the nurture flows around each appointment, create the in-clinic assets and consumer tools that capture interest, and track what converts. You'll work closely with Clinic Success and Marketing. We don't have an in-house creative team yet, so you'll write your own copy and wireframe your own emails and assets, with support available.

Your impact, measured in plan sales, will be felt by clinics and pet parents alike. Clinic teams get clear, client-facing materials that explain Snout in the exam room and at home. Pet parents get the right information at the right time, so they enroll understanding exactly what their plan covers and start as confident, engaged members. And Snout learns which messages and channels drive enrollment, so we can scale what works and get more pets the care they need.

If you're a builder who likes taking an idea from a blank page to launch, a writer who can turn plan benefits into a clear reason to act, and a marketer who wants to see the numbers behind every send, we'd love to hear from you.

Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.

🛠 What you’ll do


  • Own the prospect journey from first lead capture through completed enrollment, mapping lead stages, triggers, timing and handoffs so every pet parent gets a relevant next step
  • Build and improve direct-to-client nurture journeys for pre-appointment, post-visit, incomplete enrollment and lapsed prospects, segmented by appointment details, clinic, species, breed, age and behavior
  • Expand and maintain Snout's in-clinic assets (flyers, posters and exam-room pieces), each with QR attribution so it can be tested and improved
  • Create consumer tools, like pet health guides by species, breed and age, that put Snout's data to work capturing and nurturing prospects
  • Design custom assets and journeys for corporate partners alongside the teams who manage those relationships
  • Track funnel performance and test messaging, timing and channels to grow plan sales and conversion

💡What we're looking for


  • 4+ years experience in growth, conversion, acquisition or lifecycle marketing
  • Experience owning a prospect journey from lead capture through completed purchase or enrollment, ideally in a B2B2C or partner-led consumer channel
  • Hands-on experience building marketing automation workflows triggered by prospect behavior, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing and funnel reporting
  • Strong copywriting, with a portfolio of customer-facing emails, campaigns or landing pages that turn product benefits into clear, conversion-focused messaging
  • Ability to wireframe, or ideally build, your own emails, landing pages and marketing assets
  • Experience connecting offline touchpoints to online conversion (ex. QR codes or promo codes), and a track record of taking work from first idea through launch

🌟 What will make you stand out


  • Pet, veterinary or healthcare industry background
  • Experience developing referral, loyalty, member perks or community programs
  • Experience turning CX feedback and cancellation reasons into education and engagement campaigns
  • Familiarity with Marketo, Customer.io or similar platforms (including SMS or in-app messaging), design tools like Canva or Figma, and AI tools for ideation and execution

💖 Why you should join Snout


  • Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
  • Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
  • Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
  • Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you


  • A fast-moving, startup culture feels overwhelming to you and you aren't comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go
  • You'd rather set strategy and brief a creative or ops team than write, design and build the work yourself
  • Your experience is mostly paid media or ad budgets; this role grows enrollment through clinic partners, owned channels and in-clinic materials
  • You prefer inheriting an established program to building the first version and measuring it from scratch
  • You don't live near an airport or have the flexibility to travel quarterly

💸 Compensation


  • $120 000 - 140 000 base salary

⚕️Benefits


  • Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits
  • Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays
  • Paid parental leave

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

We're looking for an SEO Content Specialist to help execute our content and AI-first search strategy. You'll build topical authority and create content that ranks on search engines and gets cited by AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Your work will be measured by its impact on traffic, AI visibility and sign-ups, not by how much you publish.

Responsibilities

  • Write, edit and refresh content that meets E-E-A-T standards: real expertise, author credibility, accurate sources and first-hand insight.
  • Collaborate and work closely with the content team to plan, brief and produce content that supports our search and AI visibility goals.
  • Collaborate and work closely with the tech team to implement technical SEO changes, schema and site improvements, and make sure they ship on time.
  • Create content frameworks, including templates, brief formats and structure guidelines, so content is consistent, AI-first and easy to produce at scale.
  • Track AI visibility and citations against competitors, test new tactics, and adjust the strategy based on what works.
  • Improve click-through rates from search by testing and optimising titles, meta descriptions and rich results.
  • Make our content AI-first, so it's easy for both search engines and LLMs to retrieve, understand and cite. That means clear answers, structured formats, entity-rich copy and strong source signals.
  • Research keywords, entities and search intent, and plan semantically complete content around business goals.
  • Build topical maps and pillar-cluster (hub-and-spoke) content structures that establish topical authority in our core areas.
  • Own on-page and technical SEO: internal linking, schema markup, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals and site architecture.
  • Report monthly on traffic, rankings, CTR, AI visibility and conversions.
  • Help execute our AEO and GEO strategy, supporting decisions on which topics, questions and platforms to prioritise so the brand shows up in AI-generated answers.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • 3-5 years of experience in SEO content writing or content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Proven experience creating topical maps and content frameworks, and turning them into pillar-cluster content plans.
  • Hands-on experience with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and a CMS such as WordPress.
  • Solid technical SEO knowledge, including site audits, schema, internal linking, indexation issues and basic HTML.
  • A practical understanding of AEO, GEO and how LLMs and AI search engines find and cite content.
  • A strong grasp of topical authority, topic clusters, semantic SEO, entities and E-E-A-T.
  • Experience executing SEO or content strategies with measurable results.
  • Strong ownership, attention to quality and a record of delivering on time.

Details

  • Fully remote based in India
  • Salary: $15,000-$20,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included 🎉), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

The Application Process

We have 6 stages:

  1. Apply here and fill out our questions to tell us about you!
  2. Prescreen Call with the Talent Team
  3. Interview with Hiring Manager
  4. Assignment
  5. Panel/Final Interview
  6. Background & Reference Checks

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply today and let us know why. We look forward to hearing from you!

Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

Customer Success Manager 

At Cardata, customers are at the centre of everything we do. Our Customer Success team protects retention by helping customers get greater value from their reimbursement programs and building strong, lasting relationships.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of customer relationships after implementation, helping customers navigate their programs, resolve challenges, and achieve meaningful business outcomes while contributing to Cardata's GRR and NRR goals.

This is a hands-on role that combines customer relationship management with problem-solving and day-to-day execution and management of customer expectations. You'll develop a strong understanding of our platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently investigate issues, troubleshoot challenges, and guide customers toward practical solutions.

You'll thrive here if you're naturally curious and enjoy learning, are resourceful, highly organized, and an excellent communicator. You enjoy digging into complex problems, finding answers, and balancing competing priorities while ensuring customers feel supported and nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a remote-first role with occasional travel, approximately 2–3 times per quarter.

What you'll do

  • Own a portfolio of customer relationships, understanding their business objectives, reimbursement programs, and ongoing needs to deliver a responsive, reliable customer experience while managing customer expectations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer challenges, using platform knowledge, documentation, data, and internal resources to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions through to completion.
  • Manage a high volume of customer requests, triaging inquiries, prioritizing by urgency and business impact, and maintaining clear ownership of deadlines and follow-ups and managing customer expectations.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, setting expectations, explaining complex information, and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
  • Develop deep knowledge of Cardata's platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently answer questions, guide customers, and identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness.
  • Monitor customer health, adoption, and program performance, identifying risks and taking action to protect retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Lead customer check-ins, and renewal preparation, using customer insights to demonstrate value and provide practical recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes and expand value, partnering with Account Managers on potential growth opportunities.
  • With support of Customer Success Associate, interpret data insights to inform customer conversations and recommendations.
  • Partner with Support, Product, Engineering, and Implementation to coordinate resolutions, address recurring issues, and improve the customer experience.

What you'll bring

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and resourcefulness to investigate unfamiliar issues, identify root causes, and independently drive resolution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information, manage stakeholder expectations, and navigate challenging customer conversations.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn SaaS platforms, understand operational workflows, and navigate interconnected systems.

The expected base compensation for this role is 68,000–76,000 CAD annually, dependent on experience and competency. This role is also eligible for target variable incentives of 5,000-10,000 CAD, with actual earnings dependent on experience, skills, and performance.

This is a vacant position, and we are seeking someone who will bring a new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

jobs.description:

About ComPsych

تُعد شركة ComPsych® Corporation أكبر مزود عالمي لخدمات الصحة النفسية وبرامج GuidanceResources® للحياة. وانطلاقاً من التزامها الراسخ بالابتكار المتواصل وتبنيها لنهج شامل في تقديم الرعاية، توفر ComPsych خدماتها لأكثر من 163 مليون فرد موزعين على 200 دولة. وتحت مظلة علامتنا التجارية GuidanceResources®، نقدم برامج مخصصة ومتكاملة تماماً تشمل مجالات الصحة السلوكية، وإدارة حالات الغياب، ومسارات العافية؛ وهي برامج تهدف إلى تمكين الموظفين من عيش حياة أكثر صحة وإنتاجية، فضلاً عن تعزيز التميز المؤسسي. تفضل بزيارة موقع compsych.com لتكتشف الأسباب التي دفعت 40% من الشركات المدرجة ضمن قائمة "Fortune 500" لاختيار ComPsych لتلبية احتياجاتها المتعلقة بالصحة النفسية.

 

 

ComPsych® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.

About the Role

 

المسمى الوظيفي هو "استشاري توجيه" (Guidance Consultant)، وهي وظيفة تعتمد نظام العمل عن بُعد ومقرها دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. تُعد هذه الوظيفة عقداً محدد المدة وبدوام كامل، وهي مثالية للمتخصصين في مجال الصحة النفسية ممن يقدّرون التميز السريري ويتحلون بالتعاطف في نهجهم المهني، فضلاً عن قدرتهم على النجاح والتميز في بيئة عمل سريعة الإيقاع تضع سهولة الوصول وسرعة الاستجابة والرعاية المتمحورة حول العميل في

 

يقوم مستشارو التوجيه بتقديم دعم مباشر للعملاء عبر الهاتف والمحادثات النصية، حيث يتناولون القضايا المتعلقة بالصحة السلوكية، والرفاه العاطفي، والشؤون الأسرية، ومسائل العافية الشاملة؛ وذلك بمنتهى الاحترافية والتعاطف، وبالاستناد إلى حكم سريري سديد.

 

وبصفتها جزءاً من أكبر جهة مزودة في العالم لـ "برامج مساعدة الموظفين" (EAP) وخدمات الرعاية المُدارة للصحة السلوكية، فإن هذه الوظيفة تتيح فرصة استثنائية للنمو المهني. إذ يوظف المستشارون خبراتهم السريرية لتقديم الدعم الفوري في لحظة الحاجة، وتوجيه العملاء نحو الموارد المتاحة، وتسهيل إجراء الإحالات المناسبة وفي الوقت المناسب، لضمان استمرارية الرعاية وتحقيق نتائج إيجابية.

 

 

 

The job title is Guidance Consultant and is a remote working role residing in the country of United Arab Emirates. This is a Fixed-Term, Full-Time position and is ideal for mental health professionals who value clinical excellence and lead with empathy, and who thrive in a fast-paced environment where access, responsiveness, and client-centered care are essential.

 

Guidance Consultants provide direct client support via telephone and chat, addressing behavioral health, emotional well-being, family concerns, and overall wellness-related issues with professionalism, compassion, and sound clinical judgment.

 

As part of the world’s largest provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and managed behavioral health care services, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for professional growth. Consultants leverage their clinical expertise to deliver in-the-moment support, guide clients through available resources, and facilitate timely, appropriate referrals to ensure continuity of care and positive outcomes.

 

What You'll Do

تقديم الدعم عبر الهاتف والمحادثة النصية من خلال إجراء تقييمات سريرية أولية شاملة، وإحالة العملاء إلى الموارد المناسبة، بما في ذلك المعالجون النفسيون، والمرشدون، وموارد العافية ذات الصلة.

 إجراء تقييمات للعملاء وتطبيق منهجيات التدريب (Coaching) لتطوير استراتيجيات مخصصة للصحة والعافية تدعم إحداث تغيير إيجابي في السلوك.

 ضمان الالتزام ببروتوكولات القسم، وأفضل الممارسات المتبعة في القطاع، والمتطلبات الخاصة بالعملاء؛ وذلك للحفاظ على الامتثال التنظيمي وضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة.

 تقديم الخدمات بأسلوب يتسم بالكفاءة الثقافية، والشمولية، والاحترام للأفراد من خلفيات متنوعة وذوي احتياجات متباينة.

 توظيف التقدير السليم للمواقف، والتفكير النقدي، ومهارات حل المشكلات لتقييم الحالات، ومعالجة الشواغل بسرعة، وتسهيل تقديم الدعم المناسب لتعزيز تجربة العميل الشاملة.

 توعية العملاء بالموارد المتاحة، ومعايير الأهلية، والخدمات التي يقدمها البرنامج بأسلوب مهني ومتعاطف.

 الحفاظ على توثيق دقيق وشامل وفي الوقت المناسب لجميع التفاعلات مع العملاء ضمن نظام قاعدة البيانات الخاص بالمؤسسة.

 البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث الاتجاهات والموارد وأفضل الممارسات الناشئة في مجال الصحة السلوكية، وذلك لتعزيز جودة تقديم الخدمات بشكل مستمر.

 التعاون مع الأطراف المعنية (أصحاب المصلحة) داخل المؤسسة وخارجها لضمان استمرارية الرعاية ومواءمة الخدمات مع التوقعات المحددة لكل عميل.

الالتزام الصارم بالسرية الطبية ولوائح حماية البيانات المعمول بها (مثل: GDPR في أوروبا، وPDPA في سنغافورة، وPIPEDA في كندا، وPDPL في الإمارات العربية المتحدة).

 أداء أي مهام إضافية أخرى تُسند إليه.

 

 

  • Provide telephonic and chat support by conducting comprehensive clinical intakes and referring clients to appropriate resources, including therapists, counselors and relevant wellness resources.
  • Conduct client assessments and apply coaching methodologies to develop tailored health and well-being strategies that support positive behavior change
  • Ensure adherence to departmental protocols, industry best practices, and customer-specific requirements to maintain compliance and high-quality service delivery.
  • Deliver services in a culturally competent, inclusive, and respectful manner to individuals from diverse backgrounds with varying needs.
  • Apply sound judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess situations, resolve concerns promptly, and facilitate appropriate support to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Educate clients regarding available resources, eligibility criteria, and program services in a professional and empathetic manner.
  • Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely documentation of all client interactions within the organization’s proprietary database system.
  • Stay informed on emerging behavioral health trends, resources, and best practices to continuously enhance service delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure continuity of care and alignment with client-specific service expectations.
  • Maintain strict adherence to medical confidentiality and applicable data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR in Europe, PDPA in Singapore, PIPEDA in Canada, PDPL in UAE)
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

 يُشترط الحصول على درجة الماجستير أو ما يعادلها من مؤهلات الدراسات العليا في علم النفس، أو الخدمة الاجتماعية، أو الصحة السلوكية، أو أي مجال ذي صلة بالصحة السلوكية من مؤسسة معترف بها.

 في حال كان الإطار التنظيمي المهني المعمول به في بلد أو ولاية العمل يعترف بشهادة البكالوريوس كمعيار أساسي للالتحاق بالتخصص ذي الصلة، يُمكن اعتبار هذه الشهادة من مؤسسة معترف بها، بالإضافة إلى الخبرة العملية ذات الصلة بعد الحصول عليها، معادلةً لها.

 يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة لممارسة المهنة و/أو الحصول على الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثما يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة للتأهل للممارسة المهنية و/أو الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثم

  يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

 الأهلية لممارسة المهنة و/أو التسجيل في بلد الإقامة وفقًا للوائح الوطنية

 إجادة استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس وأنظمة معلومات العملاء

 إجادة اللغتين الإنجليزية والعربية (لغة الإمارات العربية المتحدة)

 يُفضل الحصول على شهادات معترف بها في مجال التدريب الصحي أو العافية

 يُفضل الخبرة في العمل ضمن بيئات متعددة الثقافات أو دولية

 القدرة على تقديم دعم يركز على العميل مع تعاطف قوي، ومهارات استماع فعّالة، ومهارات تدريبية

 قدرة عالية على التقييم السريري وإدارة المواقف عالية الخطورة أو الأزمات

 مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع توجه قوي نحو خدمة العملاء

 القدرة على التفكير النقدي وإدارة مهام متعددة في بيئات عمل سريعة الوتيرة

 مستوى عالٍ من الاحترافية والنزاهة والحساسية الثقافية

 القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة بسرية تامة والحفاظ على خصوصيتها

 سرعة البديهة، والنشاط، والإيجابية، والاحترافية، مع مهارات مثبتة في إدارة المهام المتعددة والتفكير النقدي وإدارة الأزمات أو المواقف عالية الخطورة

 

متطلبات أخرى

 

يُشترط توفر اتصال إنترنت عالي السرعة ومستقر وموثوق، بالإضافة إلى مساحة عمل خالية من المشتتات أو المقاطعات أو الضوضاء.

القدرة على الظهور عبر الكاميرا أثناء التدريبات والاجتماعات والفعاليات المتعلقة بالعمل.

يجب أن تكون قادراً على الجلوس أو الوقوف أمام المكتب لفترات طويلة أثناء العمل على جهاز الحاسوب.

 

 

  • Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Psychology, Social Work, Behavioral Health, or a related behavioral health field from a recognized institution is required.
  • Where the applicable professional regulatory framework in the country or jurisdiction of employment recognizes a Bachelor's-level qualification as the standard entry-level professional credential for the relevant discipline, such qualification from a recognized institution, combined with relevant post-qualification experience, may be considered equivalent.
  • Candidates must meet all educational and experiential requirements for eligibility for professional practice and/or licensure or registration with the applicable regulatory authority in their jurisdiction of employment, where such registration or licensure is required by law or regulation.
  • Eligibility for professional practice and/or registration in the country of residence as required by national regulations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and client information systems required
  • Professional bilingual proficiency in English and United Arab Emirates language (Arabic) required
  • Recognized health or wellness coaching credentials preferred
  • Experience working in multicultural or international environments preferred
  • Ability to provide client-centered support with strong empathy, active listening, and coaching skills
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to manage high-risk or crisis situations
  • Excellent communication skills with a strong service orientation
  • Ability to think critically and multitask in fast-paced environments
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and cultural sensitivity
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality
  • Quick thinking, high energy, positive, and professional, with demonstrated multi-tasking and critical thinking skills managing manage crisis or high-risk situations

 

Other Requirements

  • Consistent and reliable high-speed internet and workspace free from distraction, disruption, or noise is required
  • Ability to be present on camera during work-related trainings, meetings, and/or events
  • Must be able to sit or stand at a desk for prolonged periods while working on a computer

Compensation and Benefits

يتراوح نطاق الأجر لهذا المنصب ما بين 110,000 و128,560 درهماً إماراتياً سنوياً. وسيتم تحديد قيمة التعويضات وفقاً لمعدلات السوق المحلية السائدة والمتطلبات القانونية المعمول بها. وفي الحالات التي يقتضيها القانون الساري، سيتم تزويد المرشحين بمعلومات نطاق الراتب خلال عملية التوظيف أو بناءً على طلبهم.

تُقدَّم المزايا وفقاً لقانون العمل الإماراتي، وتشمل الإجازة السنوية، والعطلات الرسمية، والتأمين الصحي الإلزامي، ومكافأة نهاية الخدمة. وسيتم تقديم تفاصيل إضافية خلال مرحلة تقديم العرض.

 

 

نحن جهة توظيف تكفل تكافؤ الفرص، ونلتزم بممارسات توظيف عادلة وشفافة وقائمة على الجدارة. سيتم النظر في طلبات التوظيف المقدمة من جميع المتقدمين المؤهلين دون أي تمييز يستند إلى العمر، أو الجنس، أو الهوية الجندرية أو التعبير عنها، أو التوجه الجنسي، أو العرق، أو اللون، أو الأصل الإثني، أو الجنسية، أو الدين أو المعتقد، أو الإعاقة، أو حالة الحمل أو الوضع الأبوي، أو الحالة الاجتماعية أو الأسرية، أو الوضع العسكري أو وضع المحاربين القدامى، أو الخلفية الاجتماعية والاقتصادية، أو المعلومات الجينية، أو أي خصائص أخرى يحميها القانون المحلي أو الوطني أو الدولي المعمول به.

نحن ملتزمون بتوفير عملية توظيف شاملة وميسرة للجميع. إذا كنت بحاجة إلى أي تسهيلات أو تعديلات في أي مرحلة من مراحل عملية التوظيف بسبب إعاقة أو لأي سبب آخر، يرجى التواصل معنا عبر البريد الإلكتروني recruiter@compsych.com، وسنعمل معك لتلبية احتياجاتك.

 

تلتزم شركة ComPsych Corporation وشركاتها التابعة بالتعامل مع بياناتك الشخصية بمسؤولية وشفافية. سيتم استخدام المعلومات التي يتم جمعها أثناء عملية التوظيف لتقييم طلبك، وحيثما ينطبق ذلك، لإعداد وإدارة عرض التوظيف المقدم إليك. ستتم معالجة بياناتك الشخصية وفقاً لقوانين الخصوصية المعمول بها في بلد إقامتك أو نطاق ولايتك القضائية، والتي قد تشمل قانون خصوصية المستهلك في كاليفورنيا (CCPA)، واللائحة العامة لحماية البيانات في الاتحاد الأوروبي (GDPR)، وقانون حماية المعلومات الشخصية والوثائق الإلكترونية في كندا (PIPEDA) والتشريعات الإقليمية المتعلقة بالخصوصية، وغيرها من قوانين الخصوصية الوطنية أو المحلية السارية. للحصول على تفاصيل كاملة حول البيانات الشخصية التي نجمعها، وكيفية استخدامنا لها، وحقوقك بصفتك متقدماً للوظيفة، وكيفية التواصل معنا لطرح أسئلة تتعلق بالخصوصية، يرجى مراجعة إشعارات خصوصية بيانات المتقدمين ذات الصلة: "إشعار حماية البيانات للمتقدمين للوظائف في المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية وسويسرا والمملكة المتحدة" و"إشعار خصوصية المتقدمين للوظائف على المستوى العالمي".

jobs.title: MedAmerica: Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sacramento, California, United States
URL: https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

 

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

 

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.
  • Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.
  • Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.
  • Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.
  • Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.
  • Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.
  • Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.
  • Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.
  • Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.
  • Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.
  • Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.
  • Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.
  • Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.
  • Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.
  • Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.
  • Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning & Development professionally.
  • May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.
  • Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.
  • Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.
  • Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.
  • Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.
  • Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.
  • Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.
  • Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.
  • Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.
  • Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.
  • Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions
  • Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.
  • Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.
  • Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.
  • Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.
  • Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.
  • Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
  • Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
  • Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
  • Professional and Career Development Program
  • EAP and travel assistance included
  • Wellness program
  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

 

Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Vituity is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

 

*Benefits for part-time and per diem vary. Please speak to a recruiter for more information.

 

Applicants only. No agencies please.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medamerica-instructional-designer

jobs.title: Reddit: Frontend Engineer, Ads
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Team Description

The Brand Ad Formats team drives the development of ad formats that help advertisers maximize reach and brand impact. They focus on high-visibility, awareness-driven solutions that create memorable experiences for Reddit users. By delivering guaranteed placements and engaging ad interactions, they support major brand initiatives and help advertisers achieve measurable outcomes.  The team is building fully customizable interactive formats and AI-driven ads that incorporate User-Generated Content (UGC).  Moving forward, we will be doubling down on Video Ads, with the goal of turning Reddit into an industry leader and a ‘must buy’ for advertisers to promote video content.

Role Description

The Brand Ad Formats team is seeking a skilled Frontend engineer with a product-focused mindset to join the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Build Ad experiences and create patterns for Reddit’s web app that enhance our ads’ performance and functionality.
  • Collaborate across product, design, and engineering teams to innovate and implement sophisticated solutions for complex challenges.
  • Engage in the full development cycle: design, develop, QA, experiment, analyze, and deploy.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Web Engineering
  • Proficient in Typescript and Javascript
  • A willingness to tackle the challenges of creating data-intensive, highly responsive, and fault-tolerant apps
  • Experience with automated testing best practices, code quality / design patterns, observability, etc.
  • Skilled at performing insightful code reviews, and receiving feedback themself
  • Experience leveraging GenAI tools to increase software engineering productivity
  • Excellent communication skills: able to collaborate with teams in a fully remote environment, and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on ad tech
  • Experience working on consumer facing sites (high production value at scale)

Technologies used on the team include:

  • Languages: Typescript, HTML, CSS, Go
  • Frameworks: React, Thrift, gRPC
  • Tools: Kubernetes, Docker, Codex, Cursor

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. jobs.title: Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.title: Samsara: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.samsara.com/

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

  • Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
  • Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
  • Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
  • Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
  • Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
  • Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
  • Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
  • Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
  • Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
  • A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
  • Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$162,400—$290,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.

About Beamable 

Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated.

Beamable is part of FIRY, a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR, our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it.

About the Role 

Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios.

As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth.

Responsibilities 

  •  Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively.

Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case.

Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform.

Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews.
 
 

Key Competencies
