jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

  • Annual bonus potential

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

About the Role

Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. About the Role

Help shape the future of Avast’s digital protection experience freemium experience. As a Principal Product Designer at Gen, you’ll design how people discover Avast, get value from our free products and choose to upgrade to paid protection—creating experiences that earn their trust and keep them coming back.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end product design role, combining strong UX thinking with excellent visual and UI craft. You’ll take work from discovery and research through to polished, shipped experiences across mobile, desktop and web, with a clear focus on acquisition, conversion and retention.

We’re looking for someone who has designed and shipped mobile-first consumer products at scale, with a portfolio showing what you personally owned, the decisions you made and the impact your work delivered.

You’ll also help shape AI-powered experiences that make digital protection simpler, more useful and more personal. Working closely with product, research and engineering, you’ll influence design direction while staying close to the detail of the work.

Gen's Global Product Design team is a diverse, distributed group working across London, Prague, Dublin and the US. The global team designs across cybersecurity, identity protection, privacy and financial wellness, with a strong focus on AI-enabled experiences and reimagining key user journeys. This role sits within the cyber safety pillar, working primarily on Avast and its freemium ecosystem, while staying closely connected to the wider design community across Gen's brands.

  • Experience designing for or alongside AI-driven features such as personalisation, recommendations or automation is a strong plus

  • Experience in cybersecurity or financial services is helpful, but curiosity and adaptability matter more

Skills:

  • Strategic mindset with a keen sense of how design drives user value and business growth

  • Mastery of end-to-end product design: UX research, interaction, visual design and systems thinking

  • Deep user empathy and a belief in data-informed design decisions

Personal Attributes:

  • Curious, adaptable and motivated by solving complex problems for real people at scale

  • A clear, compelling portfolio that demonstrates your design process and product impact

The annual base salary for this position is expected to be in the range of base salary

GBP 80,000 - 100,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes annual bonus and new hire RSU's. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role.

At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees' well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes:

  • Health & Wellbeing: company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

  • Financial Security: a Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Your CV and portfolio will be reviewed by the recruiter and hiring manager to understand the scope of your work, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the role.

 

If your experience aligns with what we're looking for, our recruiter will be in touch to arrange a conversation about your background, what motivates you, your interest in Gen and our products, and what to expect from the interview process.

jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Sales Team Lead is a pivotal commercial role responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a sales team. The position focuses on driving sales performance, optimizing pipeline management, and ensuring operational excellence to support sustainable revenue growth.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to execute strategic initiatives, maintain KPI ownership, and foster a high-performance culture. This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys developing top talent, and brings a strong commercial mindset.

We offer a clear career growth path, competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact at our Berlin headquarters, backed by leading international investors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Performance & Operations

  • Drive commercial performance and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.

  • Lead day-to-day sales execution and monitor weekly and monthly KPIs.

  • Own pipeline management and ensure accurate, disciplined forecasting.

  • Maintain visibility over pipeline health, market developments, and overall sales performance.

  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve sales processes and operational efficiency.

  • Implement and reinforce best practices, reporting standards, and performance tracking to ensure consistent execution.

2. Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing sales team in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, setting clear expectations and standards for success.

  • Drive a strong performance culture built on accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement.

  • Coach and develop team members through regular 1:1s, deal reviews, live feedback, and hands-on support.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership on hiring, onboarding, and developing top talent to ensure long-term team strength.

  • Identify growth opportunities within the team and actively support career development and internal progression.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement of sales targets and pipeline objectives.

  • A highly engaged and high-performing sales team.

  • Strong forecasting accuracy and operational discipline.

  • Improved sales productivity, conversion rates, and overall team efficiency.

Who You Are

  • 4–6+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or sales leadership roles.

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, or coaching sales teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong understanding of sales KPIs, pipeline management, and sales operations.

  • Hands-on, proactive mindset with strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

  • Additional European language (German, Italian, or French) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a high-performance, office-based environment.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

    • What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.
    • If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

    Why People Join Us

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

    Before You Hit Apply

Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We’re looking for Contractors in Software Development (Senior level or Technical Lead) to help our major clients transform. 

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, extreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.

Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.

Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Requirements

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must either currently hold active Security Check (SC) Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

As attendance at client sites is a routine part of the role’s working pattern and involves occasional travel, travel expenses are not covered.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in Java and/or Scala is required
  • Experience in other languages such as Javascript, Typescript, Kotlin, Python or Ruby is also valuable
  • Experience in a technical leadership role
  • Deep understanding of programming paradigm, code design, testing, accessibility, performance and security
  • Proven ability to apply different testing tools and methods in practice
  • Knowledge or experience of delivering complex services to Government Digital Service (GDS) standards
  • Being comfortable with new technology, t-shaped and comfortable with ongoing learning and development is key to success

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

jobs.title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field.

You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output.



 


Responsibilities

  • First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units.

  • Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors.

  • Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches.

  • Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier.

  • Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures.

  • Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers.

  • See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed.

  • Keep failure, test and repair records traceable.

  • Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects.


    • Requirements

  • You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product.

  • You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together.

  • You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them.

  • You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack.

  • You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure.

  • You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor.


    • Plus

  • Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics

  • Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR

  • Experience designing electronics PCBAs

  • Experience in software programming

  • SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt

  • Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis

  • Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software

  • Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD

  • Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams

  • Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA

  • Speaking or understanding German

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Commercial Account Executive Summary:

This position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into a geographic territory for Commercial Accounts, as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue of $500M or less.

Travel may be required to visit customers, attend trade shows or field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick-offs or quarterly business reviews. With our strong promote-from-within philosophy, successful performance in this role will provide career advancement opportunities to those seeking to take their sales careers to the next level.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. jobs.title: Expansion manager France / Développeur.se Immobilier - Nord et IDF
jobs.description:
Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! 

  • Tu vis dans la région parisienne et tu y as déjà un réseau conséquent;

  • Tu as +3 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseignes ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour. 

  • 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur.

  • Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail.

  • Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios.

  • Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée.

  • Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

  • Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ;

  • Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager

  • Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ;

  • Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France.

jobs.title: Senior Client Partner – Steuerlösungen Public Sector (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Information Factory steht für Management Consulting, Technologie und datenbasierte Lösungen. Für die Betreuung führender kantonaler Steuerverwaltungen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer etablierten Steuerlösungen suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Kundenbeziehungen, Fachprozesse und Technologie miteinander verbindet.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden fachlich-technische Roadmaps und sorgst dafür, dass unsere geschäftskritischen Lösungen nachhaltigen Nutzen schaffen. Dabei verbindest du Lösungsdesign, Betrieb, Sicherheit, Organisation und die Perspektive der Fachbereiche.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Wichtige Kundenbeziehungen im kantonalen Steuerumfeld betreuen und weiterentwickeln

  • Client-Success-Pläne mit messbaren Ergebnissen und klaren Review-Punkten entwickeln

  • Kundennutzen, Adoption und Beziehungsqualität steuern und Risiken früh erkennen

  • Fachlich-technische Mehrjahres-Roadmaps mit Fachbereich, IT, Betrieb und Management erarbeiten

  • Bestehende Steuerlösungen und das Lösungsportfolio im Public Sector weiterentwickeln

  • Informationssicherheit, Auditierbarkeit, Business Continuity und hohe Verfügbarkeit einbeziehen

  • Neue Vorhaben identifizieren und Angebote gemeinsam mit dem Account Management entwickeln

Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Delivery

Du verantwortest Kundenbeziehung, Kundenergebnisse, Adoption, gemeinsame Roadmap und Account-Entwicklung. Der Solution Delivery Manager verantwortet Umsetzung, Umfang, Termine, Budget, Qualität, Releases und Betriebsbereitschaft. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für realistische Zusagen und klare Erwartungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung oder einen gleichwertigen Leistungsausweis mit komplexen strategischen Kunden

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Verantwortung für ein geschäftskritisches System oder eine vergleichbare Lösungslandschaft im Betrieb

At Finom, we empower our employees to make a real difference. We nurture an innovative and inspiring environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation, and ensuring every effort benefits our users, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Engineering Manager - Product
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager who's both a technical leader and a product builder. You'll guide a cross-functional team (5-10 engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA) in delivering products that create real value for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

What You Will Be Doing
  • You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.

    • Who You Are
  • 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust

    • Our tech stack

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    We're a growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of European businesses. You'll lead a domain team with real ownership and autonomy over what you build and how you build it. This is a place for curious leaders who want to grow as technical managers, product thinkers, and people leaders.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

jobs.description:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.
 
Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.
 
Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Business Development, Strategie, Projektmanagement – und das alles am liebsten gleichzeitig? Dann suchen wir genau dich. Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) wirst du zur rechten Hand unserer CFO und zum Motor abteilungsübergreifender Projekte. Kein Tag wie der andere, kein Problem zu groß.

Deine Aufgaben:
  • Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) arbeitest du eng mit unserer CFO und dem gesamten Management Team zusammen. Du diskutierst und hinterfragst strategische Entscheidungen, koordinierst nachhaltige Effizienzsteigerungen und steuerst abteilungsübergreifende Projekte oder stößt diese an
  • Du leitest funktionsübergreifende Initiativen, um die rechtzeitige Durchführung und den erfolgreichen Abschluss von Projekten sicherzustellen. Der Schwerpunkt liegt hierbei auf Wachstum, Skalierung und Innovation
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Mitarbeiter*innen und Führungskräften hast du immer ein offenes Ohr. Über alle Teams und Hierarchie-Ebenen hinweg sorgst du mit direkter Kommunikation und einem regelmäßigen Austausch für ein produktives Arbeitsklima

  • Arbeite funktionsübergreifend über unsere Business Units hinweg um Herausforderungen zu identifizieren, Lösungsansätze zu formulieren und Veränderungen voranzutreiben
  • Du unterstützt bei einer Vielzahl an Themen, einschließlich End-to-End Projektmanagement, für unsere wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten. Du bist für strategische Schlüsselprojekte verantwortlich und hilfst dabei, die Gesamtstrategie des Unternehmens zu definieren

    • Dein Profil:
  • Dein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bilden die Basis deiner fachlichen Kompetenz
  • Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (idealerweise als Chief of Staff) sowie fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Business Development oder in der Strategieentwicklung 
  • Du besitzt StartUp-Mentalität, fühlst dich in der dazugehörigen Arbeitsweise wohl und bist durch ein agiles und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld beflügelt 
  • Neben deiner hohen Durchsetzungs- und Umsetzungsfähigkeit, verfolgst du einen proaktiven wie strukturierten Arbeitsansatz
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent, starke Führungsqualitäten und die Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren
  • Neben ausgeprägtem analytischem und konzeptionellem Denkvermögen, zeichnen dich zudem deine hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie dein gesunder Pragmatismus aus
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Analyse von komplexen Themengebieten und in der Erstellung von Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete kommunikative und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie dem außergewöhnlichen Geschick, mit divergierenden Interessen der Stakeholder*innen umzugehen
  • Du bringst Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft mit und bist bereit Projekte in München, Berlin oder einem unserer anderen Standorte umzusetzen
  • Du bringst fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit
