jobs.description:
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries.

What we build

    • Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.
    • Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.
    • Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.
    • Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.
Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.
 

The 5 values we work by

    • Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.
    • Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.
    • Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.
    • Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.
    • No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.
We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.

Context 📄

How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

Key responsibilities 🚀

  • Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

At Younited, we are reinventing credit and payments to make banking simple, transparent, and inclusive. Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company.

Be part of an adventure that is only beginning!

About the Finance team

The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director.

The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company.

The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics.

Context 📄

Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team.

This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions.

Key responsibilities 🚀

  • Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards.
  • Own the budget process, business planning and reforecasts: annual budget (build, iterations, defence), multi-year business plan and periodic reforecasts, under one method and one single model.
  • Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan.
  • Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement.
  • Lead, develop and coach the FP&A team, ensuring skills development, back-up and high performance across the scope.

About you 👇

  • Seasoned finance professional with 8+ years of experience, including team management:
    • with proven experience in both FP&A / controlling and Audit / TS at a leading international firm with exposure to financial institutions, regulated environments and complex data structures,
    • with a good understanding of a market standard full management cycle — budgeting, multi-year business planning, forecasting and management reporting,
    • experienced with EPM tools is a plus,
  • Solid understanding of accounting standards and their strategic implications for financial planning and reporting (IFRS & French GAAP & regulatory),
  • A structured leader able to build method and process, set standards and drive change and continuous improvement in an evolving environment,
  • Demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines while ensuring accuracy and reliability,
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with business partners and top management (CEO, COO, CFO) and board,
  • A proactive, hands-on and detail-oriented mindset, with strong analytical skills and a genuine commitment to team development,
  • Full professional proficiency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.

Why makes the role so exciting 🌟

  • A rare opportunity to build and lead a market-standard end-to-end FP&A function in a listed company.
  • High autonomy and visibility: you own one of the most critical processes of the company and partners directly with Senior Management personnel of the Company.

Recruitment process 📅

  1. The process begins with an interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations, and how you align with Younited's values and culture (30 min).
  2. This is followed by an interview with Arthur, Finance Director, for a discussion about the position (1h).
  3. Next, you'll have one week to prepare a technical case study on an FP&A topic (management cycle, planning and business partnering), and then present your approach during a dedicated session (1h) with Arthur and a member of the Finance team.
  4. You will then meet Rémi, BU France CEO for a conversation about the banking business (1h).
  5. Finally, the process concludes with a closing conversation with Naren, Group CFO (1h).

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €165K – €180K • Offers Equity

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use agents and AI tools to improve how you work

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with digital transformation agencies, AI consultancies, regional systems integrators, or implementation partners

  • Experience activating solution partners and progressing partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities in France

  • Familiarity with AI agents, enterprise software, SaaS integrations, or technology-enabled consulting and delivery

  • Existing relationships with relevant French solution partner firms

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct commercial impact: Your work will contribute to qualified pipeline, partner-led opportunities, and revenue in France

  • A focused growth mandate: Activate assigned new and existing French Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic, with clear prioritization and commercial accountability

  • Cross-functional ownership: Connect partners with the right Dust commercial, technical, and delivery teams to make joint opportunities actionable

  • Room to build: Help shape a repeatable way for partners to introduce, sell, and support Dust as the ecosystem grows

  • A fast-moving category: Work with a product and market that are evolving quickly, alongside a team that values customer outcomes, accountability, and practical execution

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

jobs.title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

  • Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme.

  • Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen.

  • Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

  • Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

  • Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen.

  • Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

  • Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Unsere Arbeitskultur

Menschen stehen über Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität entscheidend. Wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst – und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance ein, in der berufliche Aufgaben sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind auf den Menschen ausgerichtet und ermöglichen es dir, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen – für deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Deine Sicherheit und Zufriedenheit liegen uns heute und in Zukunft am Herzen.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir fördern Offenheit und schaffen ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen und gegenseitigem Respekt geprägt ist. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke und treibt Innovation und Fortschritt voran.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft und ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung großgeschrieben werden. Werde Teil unseres Unternehmens und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie.

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als (Senior) Sales Manager (w/m/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen. In dieser zentralen Rolle fungierst du als entscheidendes Bindeglied, das Interessent:innen in zufriedene LIQID-Kund:innen verwandelt. Dein souveränes Auftreten sowie deine umfassende Kompetenz prägen den Eindruck, den Interessent:innen von LIQID gewinnen, und überzeugen sie nachhaltig, sich für unsere maßgeschneiderten Anlagelösungen zu entscheiden. Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein Gehalt durch deine starke Leistung und Motivation flexibel zu gestalten.

 

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Proaktive Kundengewinnung: Du begeisterst neue Kund:innen im Segment der vermögenden Privatkundschaft und positionierst LIQID als starken, vertrauenswürdigen Partner im digitalen Wealth Management.

  • Qualifizierte Ansprache: Auf Basis hochwertiger Leads nimmst du proaktiv Kontakt zu Interessent:innen auf, führst strukturierte Erst- und Folgegespräche und baust so von Beginn an eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung auf.

  • Onboarding & Übergabe: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Übergang der gewonnenen Kund:innen an unser Relationship-Management-Team.

  • Team- & Marktfeedback: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead Sales und Kolleg:innen zusammen, teilst aktiv Feedback zu Kundenbedürfnissen, Markttrends und Materialien und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Vertriebsaktivitäten weiterzuentwickeln.

  • CRM & Nachverfolgung: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert und transparent in unserem CRM-System und trägst so zu einer effektiven Nachverfolgung und Steuerung des Vertriebs bei.

Das bringst du mit

Background:

  • Du hast ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen oder eine Ausbildung in der Finanzbranche gemacht, zum Beispiel als Bankkaufmann/-frau, Investmentkaufmann/-frau oder Versicherungskaufmann/-frau.

  • Außerdem bringst du erste Erfahrung im aktiven Vertrieb von Finanzprodukten mit, idealerweise in der Finanzanlagenvermittlung, Vermögensverwaltung oder im (Private) Banking.

  • Du weißt also genau, wie man anspruchsvolle Kund:innen abholt und professionell informiert.

Skills & Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kapitalmärkte und Anlageprodukte und kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln.

  • Mit deiner Akquisitions- und Abschlussstärke sowie deinem professionellen Auftreten gewinnst du schnell das Vertrauen neuer Kund:innen.

  • Kommunikation ist deine Stärke; klar, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Außerdem bist du sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Reporting-Tools und digitalen Vertriebsplattformen.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch, und gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit.

Mindset:

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, zielorientiert und packst Dinge gerne aktiv an. Sales ist für dich nicht nur ein Job, sondern etwas, das dich antreibt; du liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und interessierst dich für Kapitalmärkte.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit echtem Erfolgswillen. Gleichzeitig verbindest du Überzeugungskraft mit Empathie und einem starken Servicegedanken, genau das macht dich zu einer authentischen und überzeugenden Ansprechperson.

 

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!


Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

So geht es für dich weiter

    Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: In einem fachlichen Dialog prüfen wir, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen mit den Anforderungen der Position übereinstimmen.

  • Persönliches Treffen: Hier hast du die Gelegenheit, das Team zu treffen und praxisnahe Einblicke in die Tätigkeiten eines Sales Managers zu gewinnen.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. jobs.title: AUTOSAR Embedded Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mobileye’s Automotive Software development team is looking for SW developers to work on the cutting-edge of technologies bringing to market Mobileye Autosar self-driving platforms.
 
We are looking for experienced SW developers with strong debugging skills and Autosar diagnostic experience who are passionately motivated by challenges and excel in troubleshooting complex problems.

What will your job look like:
  • Developing and configuring AUTOSAR modules, below the RTE.
  • Creating and implementing software components on top of the RTE.
  • Create design documents, SW requirements, SW unit tests and test cases.
  • Establish bi-directional traceability between SW requirements and SW design.
  • Optimization of the design or code in regards to consumption of resources.
  • Debugging on bench and in vehicle, using Lauterbach debuggers, DLT and XCP.
  • Participate in design and code and requirements reviews.
  • Perform AUTOSAR embedded software integration.
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of issues.
  • Participation in internal, customer, supplier and OEM meetings.
  • Knowledge transfer from and into the development teams.

    • All you need is:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering or equivalent technical field from an accredited institution, Masters is a strong advantage.
  • 4 years of experience on Embedded Software in automotive electrical & electronics industry
  • AUTOSAR expertise, Adaptive AUTOSAR is an advantage.
  • Strong customer orientation, willingness to meet deadlines, and self-management skills.
  • Deep passion for solving problems to resolution, including root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to work and collaborate in a dynamic and global team environment and adapt to changing priorities and customer needs.
    •  

    Nice to have:
  • Knowledge of scripting tools like Python, CAPL.
  • Experience with software engineering tools (JIRA, GIT).
  • Experience with UDS protocol / Bootloader / OEM Specific.
  • Advanced experience with NXP processors and QNX OS.
  • Advanced experience with AUTOSAR abstraction (Mcu, Wdg, Gpt, Dio, Port, Icu, …).
  • Advanced experience with AUTOSAR BSW and RTE, architecture, specifications, and configuration tools (eg. ElektroBitTresOs, Vector DaVinci).
  • Strong fundamentals programming in C, embedded system concepts, and software build process.
  • Experience with software engineering process models (Automotive Spice (ISO 15504), Functional Safety (ISO 26262), Agile, MISRA C).
  • Experience with Vector products (CANoe, CANape, vFlash, vT Family).
  • Experience with debugging methods and tools (e.g., Lauterbach Trace32).
    • Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

  • Contributing to high quality code, improving robustness and maintainability of existing code


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience in Software Engineering

  • Solid Software Engineering skills

  • Programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have


    • Bonus qualifications

  • Experience in computer networking

  • Experience in information security

  • Experience working with embedded systems

  • Experience working on production grade software system

  • Open source contributions

    • This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Germany.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

    • Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely.

  • Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan.

  • Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States.

jobs.title: Stage de Vente - Nice Cap 3000
jobs.description:
À PROPOS DE LA MARQUE
Chez Karl Lagerfeld, nous suivons le mantra suivant : « Profiter du présent et inventer le futur ».
 
Toujours contemporaine et tournée vers l’avenir, la maison KARL LAGERFELD partage la vision créative et l’esthétique de son fondateur emblématique, Karl Lagerfeld.
 
Nous sommes la seule maison de couture portant le nom de Karl et nous nous efforçons d’être à la hauteur de cette responsabilité dans tout ce que nous réalisons, chaque jour, avec la plus grande joie et passion.
 
Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée et motivée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des concepts de produit liés au monde et aux attributs emblématiques de Karl.
 
Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide.
 
Nous sommes en contact avec nos consommateurs à différents niveaux, nous assurant que notre approche à la fois en ligne et hors ligne aillent de pair. Nous nous efforçons d’optimiser l’engagement de nos clients avec plus de 200 magasins KL dans le monde, nos partenaires grossistes premium, et notre couverture numérique, avec à sa position le flagship store KARL.COM, qui est disponible dans 96 pays. Nos canaux numériques représentent plus de 30% de notre activité à plein tarif.
 
Nous sommes une entreprise dynamique, à la croissance rapide et inclusive construite sur le professionnalisme et des valeurs fortes. Chez KARL KAGERFELD, nous nous engageons à travailler avec les plus hautes normes en matière de durabilité et d’intégrité dans tous nos domaines d’activité. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint la Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur.

POSITION
La Maison KARL LAGERFELD souhaite contribuer à la formation et au succès de futurs jeunes talents de la mode. C’est dans ce but que nous proposons des stages conventionnés à temps plein pour une période de 6 mois en tant qu’assistant(e)s de ventes.
Le stage se déroulera au sein de nos corners en Grands Magasins à Nice Massena ou Nice Cap 3000.
 
Ambassadeur de la Maison KARL LAGERFELD, vous aurez pour mission:
- Assurer le meilleur accueil et service auprès d’une clientèle française et internationale
- Participer à la réalisation du chiffre d’affaires
- Participer à la mise en place du Merchandising
- Assurer le Réassort
- S’assurer de la bonne gestion des stocks
- Nous vous garantissons un suivi pédagogique allié un à environnement formateur et enrichissant.
 

PROFIL
  • Pour mener à bien ce stage, le profil suivant est requis :
  • Vous êtes doté d’une réelle finesse relationnelle, vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens du service
  • Dynamique et enthousiaste, vous avez le goût du challenge et de la vente.
  • Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais
  • Vous êtes curieux, doté d'une personnalité cool et dynamique
  • Enfin, votre esprit d’équipe, votre implication et votre état d’esprit positif vous assureront une parfaite intégration au sein de notre Maison
    •  
  • Convention de stage obligatoire - Compensation ou rémunération selon la législation.
    • Start date: March 5th, 2026

    REJOIGNEZ LA #TEAMKARL
    La vision collective de KARL LAGERFELD est d’être la marque de créateur mondiale la plus connectée, inspirant les consommateurs grâce à de luxueuses collections et les immergeant dans le Monde de Karl. Si cela vous intéresserait de rejoindre la #TEAMKARL, nous vous invitons à nous soumettre votre candidature dès aujourd’hui.
     
    Au sein de la #TEAMKARL, chacun a la liberté de donner son opinion, de faire évoluer sa carrière et de faire partie d’une équipe attentionnée et inclusive. Nous invitons les personnes de différents horizons, avec différentes perspectives, idées et expériences, à travailler avec nous.
     
     
    IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING JOB POSTINGS
     
    Please be advised that all legitimate job opportunities at KARL LAGERFELD are published exclusively on our official careers page and on selected partner platforms that redirect directly to our career site.
     
    We strongly recommend applicants to only apply through our verified channels and remain vigilant against unofficial job offers.
     
    KARL LAGERFELD will never request any form of payment during the recruitment process.
     
    If you come across suspicious job postings or receive unexpected communication about a position, please contact us immediately at -----

jobs.description:
Customer Success Operations & Business Analyst (H/F)

Stage de 6 mois – à partir de janvier 2027
Localisation : Paris

Prêt(e) à rejoindre la révolution Legal Tech ?

DiliTrust est un éditeur SaaS mondial qui transforme les directions juridiques grâce à une technologie de pointe.
En rejoignant nos équipes, vous intégrerez une scale-up SaaS en forte croissance, avec l’ambition de devenir une future licorne de la LegalTech. Vous travaillerez au cœur du business, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Customer Success, Sales et la direction, et contribuerez directement à des décisions structurantes pour l’organisation.

Vision

En tant que fournisseur de logiciels SaaS, DiliTrust est une entreprise mondiale dédiée à offrir une suite intégrée de solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre vision est de digitaliser les directions juridiques à travers le monde et de devenir un leader mondial de la Legal Tech.

Notre impact

De la génération de rapports d’assemblées générales à la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats assistée par l’intelligence artificielle, nos équipes contribuent chaque jour au succès de DiliTrust et à la satisfaction de ses clients dans un contexte international.

Notre reconnaissance

DiliTrust est à l’avant-garde de l’innovation en Legal Tech et s’attache à offrir un environnement de travail positif, entrepreneurial et stimulant.

Le rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Customer Success, vous contribuerez à structurer et à améliorer les opérations de l’équipe grâce à l’analyse de données, à la fiabilisation du CRM et à la mise en place d’outils de pilotage.
Votre mission sera de donner davantage de visibilité à l’équipe sur la performance et la santé du portefeuille clients, tout en participant à la construction de l’organisation Customer Success de demain. Les analyses, tableaux de bord et processus que vous développerez auront un impact direct sur les décisions de l’équipe et sur le suivi de nos clients.

Missions

1. Construire l’organisation de demain

  • Participer aux analyses relatives à l’organisation 2027 de l’équipe Customer Success et formuler des recommandations à partir des données disponibles.
  • Contribuer à la refonte du score de santé client et préparer les supports des comités avec la direction Customer Success.

2. Donner de la visibilité à toute l’équipe

  • Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord HubSpot permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés de l’activité : rétention, croissance, activité et performance du portefeuille.
  • Préparer les chiffres clés des rituels d’équipe et des revues de performance, et construire des business reviews clients percutantes, de l’analyse des données jusqu’à la préparation des supports.

3. Rendre notre CRM fiable et utile

  • Contribuer à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données HubSpot : comptes, propriétaires, fiches entreprises et informations relatives au suivi client.
  • Participer au regroupement des outils de suivi client dans HubSpot et travailler avec les équipes Sales afin de fluidifier le passage de relais ainsi que le suivi des renouvellements.

4. Simplifier et automatiser

  • Rédiger des modes opératoires clairs et accessibles afin d’harmoniser les pratiques de l’équipe au quotidien.
  • Contribuer à l’automatisation du suivi d’une partie du portefeuille client, identifier les possibilités de simplification et proposer des améliorations concrètes.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes actuellement étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d’ingénieurs, en université ou dans une formation spécialisée en business analytics, gestion de projet, stratégie, opérations ou relation client.
Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027 et vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement SaaS, international et en forte croissance.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
  • Votre esprit analytique et votre capacité à transformer des données en recommandations concrètes.
  • Votre rigueur et votre attention portée à la qualité des informations.

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

jobs.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Marseille, France
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

 

In particular, you will be responsible for:

  • Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.

  • Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.

  • Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.

  • Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

  • Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. 

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.

  • Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.

  • Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.

  • Technical stack:

    • Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).

    • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.

    • Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

 Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).

  • Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

  • Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth.

This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. You won't need to be an expert in every area, but you'll know when to answer yourself and when to orchestrate external support.

Reporting into our COO, you’ll become a trusted business partner to our leadership team and decision makers across Vio, pragmatically solving any problems and helping us think creatively about how we manage and mitigate our risk.

What you will do:

  • Write, review and negotiate our commercial contracts, starting with our affiliate and supply agreements

  • Be Vio's legal point of contact – orchestrating external counsel if required across all areas of the business, including but not limited to: Product and Consumer regulation (pricing transparency, DSA, GDPR, AI regulations), marketing and advertising rules, Employment (including hiring abroad and our Stock Appreciation Rights plan)

  • Corporate housekeeping and investment/transaction readiness

  • Baseline our current legal status and exposure and drive a plan to reduce legal debt

  • Get involved early alongside commercial and analytical leaders in contract and solution design, so what we build stands up to future legal scrutiny

  • Lead our outsourced legal work, including navigating the challenges of local jurisdictions

  • Drive projects that make Vio 'enterprise ready' and prepared for investment due diligence

  • Advise and educate leadership on legal risk, presenting clear options and recommendations

Who you are:

  • A technology / data oriented lawyer with significant commercial law experience

  • A legal generalist comfortable owning a broad legal portfolio and managing external specialists

  • Experienced in taking a legal function from 0 to 1, ideally in a founder-led, fast-growing company

  • Hands-on and motivated to drive projects yourself – you roll up your sleeves and get things done

  • Pragmatic, creative and a critical thinker – you don't just follow frameworks, you find solutions

  • Flexible – comfortable jumping across multiple topics in a single day

  • A concise, factual communicator who can break down complex topics and present business cases with multiple options. Able to push back when required.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen
